scope.mode: research-only existing-data diagnostic; no source edits, training, new rollouts, ablations or deployment
scope.training_reader: Existing blind_dataset.read_dataset, aggregating only rows whose split is train. The existing reader structurally parses/checksums the mixed original file before yielding; nontrain labels were not aggregated. Thus no test analysis or separate test-bank access, but not a literal claim of zero parsing of embedded test rows.
scope.validation_reader: Single raw decision at a time; retained only compact per-decision numerical summaries. Incremental seed transaction SHA256, row counts, newline termination, split validation and sample-index validation checked before accepting summaries. No raw seed or bank retained in memory.

bootstrap.estimand: decision-weighted mean, resampling whole trajectory seeds

metadata_comparison.continuation: Fresh GuardedH10 instance per trial; defaults plus explicit overrides. Main trajectory retains policy instance state. Not search_shop_v10.
metadata_comparison.world_sampler_semantics: Canonicalize observable undrawn cards, shuffle with throwaway world seed, replace RNG with seed-mode source. Shared world per index across actions; separate indices use distinct seeds. This is simulated composition-legal future sampling, not real future draw-order access.
metadata_comparison.step_cap_semantics: Includes forced action; terminal continuation shares cap. Primary target is root-blind clear, not eventual run win.
metadata_comparison.schedule_caution: decisions_per_ante quota is applied per (ante, blind_idx), not one total quota per ante. Added offset 2 means later visits within a blind, not primarily later antes. Its four-decision run cap favors early antes. Original schedule fields absent in metadata; current defaults are offset 0, stride 1, not independently proved historical values.

noise_method.contrast: Within each complete decision, each unordered candidate pair has d_k = clear_i,k - clear_j,k. Compare signs of mean(d_even) and mean(d_odd), rounding only floating arithmetic at 1e-10; K=5 each. Anchor subset includes only pairs with the anchor.
noise_method.ties: Both-tied and exactly-one-half-tied reported separately; neither treated as failures or included in sign-consistency denominator.
noise_method.K5_SE: RMS across pairs and both halves of sqrt(sample_variance(d_half, ddof=1)/5). Split-half contrast RMSE is sqrt(mean((mean(d_even)-mean(d_odd))^2)). All complete pairs included, including constant pairs.
noise_method.coupling: Covariance and correlation are computed within each pair across ten aligned worlds, not pooled across easy/hard states. Correlation excludes zero-variance marginals. Variance ratio = sum sample_var(clear_i-clear_j) / sum(sample_var(clear_i)+sample_var(clear_j)). Denominator is a zero-covariance reference, NOT an observed independent-arm control; coupling_probe=false in both banks.
noise_method.uncertainty: Pair counts are not independent sample sizes. Many pairs share decisions and seeds; training banks have only 22 and 9 seeds. Sparse informative pairs and K5 noise do not establish noise as the only bottleneck. All-clear finite samples are not proof of equal true action value.

validation.matching_checks: Unique (seed,decision_id); same complete IDs; odd vectors, anchor values, arm counts and half sizes agree with paired.records; model value recomputed from reported choice_weights dot odd vector and verified. Report lacks explicit action IDs, so action-order agreement is supported by common dataset and equal vectors, not independent action-ID mapping.
validation.selector: Sampled H10 rollout selector: maximize mean actual even-world clear outcomes. For every tied maximum, uniform expectation of odd-world values, never an odd-label tie-break. This invokes the training generator's expensive continuation concept only as an offline diagnostic, not an implemented policy.

optimistic_empirical_odd_max_regret.interpretation: Empirical odd-world candidate maximum is an optimistic sample upper reference, NOT an unbiased true oracle or rigorous upper confidence bound on true best value. Regrets inherit maximization bias.

encoder_audit.schema_mapping: Ante/hands distributions use metadata schema.context_names. Trial state is encoded immediately after forced action, before continuation; it is deliberately an afterstate value input, not a root snapshot. Hands distributions are trial-weighted. The anchor post-hands plus play indicator is only a root-hands proxy, not a verified reconstruction under every action effect.
encoder_audit.unknown_ids: No unknown joker, consumable or voucher IDs observed in either train split; unknown-state counts must not be called unknown IDs. Runtime playing-card IDs are deliberately omitted; their absence differs from unrecognized catalogue IDs.

unknown_state_classification.j_ancient: 230 original tokens; omitted suit is stored gameplay-relevant scoring target; genuine information loss.
unknown_state_classification.j_idol: 240 original tokens; rank represented, suit omitted; genuine scoring-target information loss.
unknown_state_classification.j_todo_list: 400 original and 320 added tokens; omitted target hand is gameplay-relevant reward state, changing when fulfilled. More directly an economy/long-horizon issue than proof of current-blind-clear damage.
unknown_state_classification.j_card_sharp: 160 original tokens; omitted played_hands set is gameplay relevant, but global round_played hand-type context may make it redundant in ordinary states. Do not count every occurrence as independent missing information; instance/global equivalence not universally established.
unknown_state_classification.j_burnt: 400 original tokens; implementation stores counts and most_played outside allowlist. Instance history may overlap global run counts but acquisition timing can differ; mainly future blind/planet progression relevance. Static inspection is of actual simulator implementation, not a claim of real-game fidelity.

other_limitations: Undrawn/spent/total card composition is marginal feature sums, losing rank-suit-enhancement-seal joint composition.
Held-card ordering is absent; attention hand tokens are a set. Scoring-relevant order cannot always be inferred.
Per-card run history keyed by runtime IDs omitted, despite hand-type history being retained.
Only numeric allowlisted joker state values represented; unknown_state_count records number of unrepresented names, not values or their causal importance.
Current shops, tag queues, consumable-use history excluded; especially relevant to terminal targets.
Flat control additionally pools cards and compresses joker overflow; these are not necessarily identical limitations to the structured model.
encoder_audit.conclusion: The encoding is not guaranteed Markov-sufficient. Static information loss is real, but this audit does not quantify its causal contribution to model regret. Hashing a pre-action state would not restore missing model inputs or repair labels and would change the afterstate task.

conclusions: The addition is only 33 decisions / 9 new seeds / 2600 trials versus 285 / 22 / 22800: roughly 11.6% more decisions, not a decisive test that more data cannot help.

Added data contains later within-blind decisions (many fewer remaining hands), but 27/33 decisions are still ante 1-2 and no ante 6-8 decisions. It adds only 12 different-outcome decisions and no terminal supervision.

Even/odd clear-contrast sign agreement excluding ties is about 62.6% versus 63.0% across all candidate pairs; shared-world coupling reduces estimated difference variance against a zero-covariance reference but does not eliminate K5 noise. Tiny seed banks do not identify noise as the only bottleneck.

Raw expensive selector is +0.3336 percentage points versus anchor, 95% CI [-0.0436,+0.6937]; not established superior overall, and not evidence of exact equivalence. It exceeds the original model by +0.6019 points [0.2730,0.9459], making an evaluator-learning or representation gap plausible within this domain.

Prioritize the target/candidate/horizon and usable decision-signal question before reflexively increasing network size or collecting more of the same easy states; retain evaluator learning/representation as a live bottleneck because raw selection beats model. Neither an only-noise nor an only-network explanation is supported.

Exploratory ante heterogeneity matters: raw selector is negative versus anchor in ante 1 and positive in antes 3-4. These are post-hoc strata without multiplicity correction, not an authorization for a new scoped policy.
caveats: Independent even/odd sampled worlds remove ordinary same-world selection/evaluation reuse, including tie-breaking. Finite K5 uncertainty remains; PRNG sampling independence is an assumption, not established from disjoint seed strings alone.

Complete-case conditioning requires all arms usable in both halves. Censoring may depend on actions/outcomes, so missingness can still introduce coverage/selection effects. Result is for retained policy-conditioned observable roots, not all encountered game states.
Candidates are restricted, usually eight, not all legal actions; validation has no extended candidate pool or independent-arm coupling probe.
Validation is tuning evidence, not a fresh held-out test gate; no test-bank evaluation performed. Current-blind clear advantage is not ante-8 win-rate gain.
Seed-cluster bootstrap accounts for within-seed decision dependence, not model-training uncertainty; per-ante late-game estimates are sparse.
All-clear/all-fail describe observed finite trials only. High tie prevalence alone neither invalidates labels nor establishes true indifference; no arbitrary 5% reliability threshold was applied.

Metadata/config manifest counts are requested seed ranges, not actual completed training counts. Training file sizes include metadata and potentially other splits/coverage pools; numerical counts above use train primary arms only.
Only metadata/identity hashes computed for train files; validation and model report have full file SHA256. No deployment selector was implemented.
